# Asset & image checklist — [PROJECT]

**Due:** [DATE] · **Upload to:** [LINK]

Everything visual, in one list. Send originals — the largest version you have.
I'll resize and optimise; I can't add detail that isn't there.

## Logo — the one that causes most trouble

- [ ] **Vector** primary logo — `.ai`, `.eps` or `.svg`
- [ ] Secondary / stacked version
- [ ] Icon or mark only
- [ ] Reversed (white, for dark backgrounds)
- [ ] Favicon source — square, simple, legible at 16px
- [ ] Colour codes: HEX, RGB, CMYK, Pantone

> **If you only have a JPG or PNG of your logo, say so now.** It can't be
> scaled or recoloured cleanly, and it will look soft on modern screens.
> Redrawing it is [$X] and takes about a day — much better discovered in week
> one than the day before launch.

- [ ] Print collateral to match against

## Photography

For each image: send the **original**, note where it goes, and confirm you
have the right to use it.

| # | What it is | Where it goes | Original? | Rights? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 2 | | | ☐ | ☐ |

**Common needs:**

- [ ] Hero image(s) — landscape, high resolution, room for text to sit over
- [ ] Team headshots — consistent style, same background if possible
- [ ] Premises / location
- [ ] Product shots — [N] products × [N] angles
- [ ] Work in progress / behind the scenes
- [ ] Customers or work in situ _(with permission)_
- [ ] Founder or leadership portrait

### Technical minimums

| Use | Minimum size | Format |
|---|---|---|
| Full-width hero | 2400 × 1400px | JPG or PNG original |
| Section image | 1600 × 1200px | |
| Product | 1200 × 1200px | Consistent background |
| Team headshot | 1000 × 1000px | |
| Logo | Vector | SVG / AI / EPS |
| Social share | 1200 × 630px | |

**Don't** send images pulled from your existing website — they're already
compressed and resizing them up looks worse than not having them.

**Don't** send Google Drive screenshots, photos of photos, or images embedded
in a Word document. Originals only.

### Rights — please read

For every image, confirm one of:

- [ ] We took it
- [ ] We paid a photographer and hold the rights _(check the contract — some
      licences don't cover web use)_
- [ ] Licensed stock, licence held — provide the licence
- [ ] Public domain / CC — provide the source and licence

> I can't publish an image found through a search engine. Stock photo agencies
> pursue this actively and the invoices are real. If in doubt, we'll buy a
> licence — a stock image is [$10–50] and a claim is [$1,000+].

**Do you need photography?** [ ] Yes [ ] No

If yes: half day [$X], full day [$X], or I'll recommend a photographer.

## Accessibility — alt text

Every meaningful image needs a one-line description of what it shows. Not
"image1.jpg", not a keyword stuffing exercise — what someone who can't see it
would need to know.

| Image | Alt text |
|---|---|
| | |

Decorative images don't need it; I'll mark those.

## Naming and delivery

**Name files usefully:** `team-jane-smith.jpg`, not `IMG_4471.jpg`.

**Upload to:** [LINK] — one folder, not fifteen emails.

**Don't** send images through messaging apps. WhatsApp and iMessage compress
them heavily and the quality is gone before I receive them.
